content.introduction: On November 2, 2026, the Zacks Investment Research earnings calendar lists Citigroup, The Blackstone Group, Kinder Morgan, and Aon as companies with ex-dividend dates. Citigroup will pay a dividend of $0.67 with a yield of 2.13%, The Blackstone Group will pay $1.12 with a yield of 4.28%, Kinder Morgan will pay $0.30 with a yield of 3.50%, and Aon will pay $0.82 with a yield of 1.02%. All these ex-dividend dates are on 11/2/26. The sources do not provide a definitive answer for other earnings or dividends on this date.
